name: Normalization-Failing
description: Entity normalization failed 3+ times in 15 minutes. A resource that cannot normalize never reaches order_data, so it is never attributed and never billed - and the ingestion backstop will keep republishing it, hiding the failure behind retry noise. Check the log line for shopify_id and data_type.

query_condition.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failure_count FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'python-worker' AND str_match(body, 'Failed entity normalization')
